semantics.lastCommit: Most recent verified commit SHA on this branch at the time the record was last updated. Null until a verified commit has been recorded for the change set. It does not require the current uncommitted working tree to be pre-recorded.
semantics.lastCIrun: Most recent completed Windows CI run identifier for the recorded lastCommit. Null when no verified CI run for that commit has been observed. A CI run that is generated only after a commit is recorded intentionally is not required to exist when that record is written.
